prompt: Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Use Apricot and Cypress: page #FFF9F3, text #293C32, accent #A84218, secondary surface #E4EFE7, text on accent #FFFFFF. Set headings in Young Serif and reading text in Inter; rounded expressive serif heading with neutral text. Composition: Repeated item tiles with shared metadata alignment, category headings, search and filters. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.45, reading measure at most 40ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
